topic: 近两年 Diffusion Transformer 在视频生成与世界模型中的发展

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): Agent inferred that a video/world-model Diffusion Transformer review needs both the generic DiT-video lineage (Sora/Stable Video Diffusion/Genie/Veo/HunyuanVideo/CogVideoX/Open-Sora) and the limitation/evaluation/action-conditioned world-model surfaces that static embodied taxonomy does not cover.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dit-video-core
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"diffusion transformer" AND (all:"video generation" OR all:"video synthesis")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Direct vocabulary for Diffusion Transformer applied to video generation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dit-world-model-core
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"diffusion transformer" AND all:"world model"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Diffusion Transformer used as a world model / video-world-model.

dynamic_suggestions.label: video-latent-diffusion-core
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"latent diffusion" AND (all:"video generation" OR all:"video world model")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Latent video diffusion architecture that underlies DiT-video models.

dynamic_suggestions.label: sora-lineage
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"Sora" AND (all:"diffusion" OR all:"world model" OR all:"video")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Sora demonstrated DiT on video and is a pivotal anchor even without public tech report completeness.

dynamic_suggestions.label: stv-lineage
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"Stable Video Diffusion"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Stable Video Diffusion is a canonical video diffusion method and its successors (SVD-XT, Mochi, LongMoE) form a lineage.

dynamic_suggestions.label: genie-lineage
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"Genie" AND (all:"world model" OR all:"interactive")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Genie / Genie 2 are action-conditioned video world models built on video generation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: hunyuan-cogvideo-opensora
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"HunyuanVideo" OR all:"CogVideoX" OR all:"Open-Sora"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Modern open DiT video models that report architecture, scaling, and evaluation details.

dynamic_suggestions.label: veo-moviegen-kling-wan
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"Veo" OR all:"MovieGen" OR all:"Kling" OR all:"Wan"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Nearer-term flagship video world-model/generation systems frequently benchmarked against.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dit-scaling-mechanism
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"scaling" AND (all:"diffusion transformer" OR all:"diffusion" AND all:"video")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Scaling-law evidence for diffusion transformers in video/world-model context.

dynamic_suggestions.label: rectified-flow-mechanism
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"flow matching" OR all:"rectified flow"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Flow matching / rectified flow is the training objective behind most current DiT-video and Sora-style models and shapes quality.

dynamic_suggestions.label: video-vae-mechanism
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"video autoencoder" OR all:"spatiotemporal VAE" OR all:"3D VAE"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Latent video compression/representation (3D VAE) is a core component on which DiT-video quality depends.

dynamic_suggestions.label: spatiotemporal-attention-mechanism
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"spatiotemporal attention" AND (all:"video" OR all:"diffusion")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Temporal/space-time attention design inside video DiT.

dynamic_suggestions.label: autoregressive-diffusion-hybrid-mechanism
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"autoregressive" AND all:"diffusion" AND (all:"video" OR all:"token")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Hybrid autoregressive+diffusion pipelines (e.g. W.A.L.T, next-token video models) competing with pure DiT.

dynamic_suggestions.label: physics-consistency-limitation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"physics" AND all:"video generation" AND (all:"inconsistent" OR all:"violation" OR all:"dynamics")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Core limitation: generated video lacks physical consistency/real dynamics.

dynamic_suggestions.label: temporal-consistency-limitation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"temporal consistency" AND (all:"video generation" OR all:"world model" OR all:"diffusion")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Limitation: temporal coherence and long-term consistency of generated video.

dynamic_suggestions.label: object-entity-persistence-limitation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"entity" AND all:"persistence" AND all:"video"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Limitation: object identity persistence and multimodal interaction in generated scenes.

dynamic_suggestions.label: action-conditioned-worldmodel-eval
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"action-conditioned" AND (all:"world model" OR all:"video prediction" OR all:"planning")

dynamic_suggestions.label: video-world-model-review-eval
